Running the WHOLE module (2026-07-30, both parallel and serial: 27 passed / 5 failed, EXIT=101) exposes five failures that the narrow filter hides. TWO DISTINCT CAUSES. (a) FOUR tests fail with PROCESS_LEDGER_DURABILITY_ACK_TIMEOUT ('START row for process_uuid ... was not durably acknowledged within 5000 ms'): byok_cloud_provider_selection_honors_anthropic_when_openai_also_configured (production_factory.rs:2712), official_cli_provider_selection_honors_requested_provider (:2812), cloud_success_dispatch_records_start_and_teardown_records_stop_and_unloads (:2631), from_vault_factory_cloud_spawn_records_start_and_stop (:3210).
